ja: 村田沙耶香（むらた・さやか）
１９７９年千葉県生まれ。小説家。玉川大学文学部芸術学科芸術文化コース卒業。２００３年、「授乳」で第46回群像新人文学賞優秀作受賞。09年、『ギンイロノウタ』で第31回野間文芸新人賞受賞。13年、『しろいろの街の、その骨の体温の』で第26回三島由紀夫賞受賞。16年、「コンビニ人間」で第１５５回芥川賞受賞。他の著書に『マウス』『殺人出産』『消滅世界』『地球星人』など。
en: Born in 1979 in Chiba Prefecture. Novelist. Graduated from the Art and Culture Course, Department of Arts, College of Letters, Tamagawa University. In 2003, "Breastfeeding" received a Prize of Excellence in the 46th Gunzo New Writers' Award. In 2009, she won the 31st Noma Literary New Face Prize for Silver Song. In 2013, she won the 26th Mishima Yukio Prize for The Body Heat of the Bones of That White Town. In 2016, she won the 155th Akutagawa Prize for "Convenience Store Woman." Her other books include Mouse, Birth Murder, Vanishing World and Earthlings.
